recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Secretariat accelerate the development and implementation of a strategic organizational adaptability approach across the Secretariat, along the lines called for by the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (A/78/7, para. 84), in order to enhance the management of liquidity constraints and mitigate their negative impact on the workforce, while relying on the existing human resources planning tools and policies.

history.sg_progress: The full implementation of this recommendation is subject to the availability of the necessary resources. The Administration will develop a strategic organizational adaptability approach for implementation across the Secretariat related to reviewing entities’ organizational structures and workforce modalities to ensure that they are best aligned with efficient mandate delivery and facilitate the achievement of human resources mandates given by the General Assembly, including rejuvenation and geographical representation. The approach will allow for responsiveness to changing operational contexts, evolving mandates and variability in funding.
